dataList.content:
It's evident no one—
与人对话的时候……

—taught me that showing my face is the barest courtesy when initiating conversation? I was taught, actually, but I'm not in there with you to give you an in-person greeting. 至少得遵守露个脸的基本礼仪？我知道，但我跟你们不一样，我并没待在百货店里。

<color=#a5ab8e>I'm not a customer here at the Grand Magasin. I'm one of what is called the "Giants"—the pillars that keep Sisyphe standing.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>我不是顾客，我是支撑西西弗百货的巨人之一。</color>

A "Giant," you say... Hm, what's that? A—
巨人，也就是说……

<color=#a5ab8e>—faction? Not really. The daily operations of the Grand Magasin rely entirely on us Giants' management. We don't even get to take PTO when we want to.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>比起说是某种势力，我们不过只是运营人员。百货店的日常运营离不开我们这些巨人。所以我们甚至无法随意休假。</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>Oh yeah, you might hear some of its customers calling out to disembodied "Voices" as you make your way through the Grand Magasin. That'd usually be us speaking, the "Giants." Though there might be some exceptions.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>啊，顾客们时不时提到的声音，其实就是巨人们的声音。不过有时候并不是这么回事。</color>

... You.
……你这家伙。

Are you reading my mind?
难道可以读心吗？

<color=#a5ab8e>*chuckle* Of course not. The questions were just so predictable that I couldn't help myself, that's all.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>呵呵，怎么可能。这是因为人们经常问这些问题，所以我比较容易预测人们想说什么。</color>

E-excuse me...
但……但是……

Sinclair gingerly sidled into the conversation.
辛克莱怯生生地插了一句。
If you two were in a romantic relationship... once, does that mean... 两位曾经是恋人关系……也就是说现在……

He meant it quite literally—our relationship burned with mutual yearning, the kind doused only by immediate gratification... And we never squandered so much as a single moment to get things steamy between the two of us. Until Meursault one day up and left N Corp. forever without so much as a proper goodbye. 就是字面意思哦。曾经我们从未浪费过哪怕一刻，始终在热切地追求彼此……但某一天，你永远离开了N公司，我们甚至没来得及好好道别。

<color=#a5ab8e>You did, didn't you?</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>对吧？</color>

I did.
没错。

<color=#a5ab8e>Lemme ask again, now that we've gone through a round of Liquidation. Did you return because you missed me?</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>库存整理已经结束了，让我再问你一遍吧。你是因为想我才回来的吗？</color>

As it is basic courtesy one extends to an old flame...
如果要在旧情人面前保持基本礼仪的话……

"I missed you."
我会说“我想你了”。

<color=#a5ab8e>Hehe, fine. That's good enough for me.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>呵呵，好呀。这个答案对我来说就足够了。</color>

I don't know what game you two are playing, but...
我不知道你们两个在搞什么名堂……

If you're a Giant, and if the Giants are akin to overseers of this "department store," is it within your authority to release us from here?
但如果巨人类似于运营着百货店的经理……那你是不是能把我们放出去？

... She cannot. She will not, even if it were within her ability to do so.
……那不可能。即便可以，她也不会那么做。

Right... Of course you'd know.
好吧……我猜也是。

Outis glared askance at Meursault.
奥提斯用怀疑的眼神盯着默尔索。

<color=#a5ab8e>So this new coworker of yours—she's always like this, huh? So untrusting.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>你的同伴真是生性多疑。</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>I am a Giant of the Grand Magasin—protecting and maintaining the Grand Magasin is my job. I can keep you company with stories about this place, but...</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>我是巨人，我有义务守护并维持这家百货店。我可以看着你们，并为你们讲述有关百货店的各种事情，但是……</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>... I can't pick out just the 13 of you like it's a crane game.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>我不能像玩抓娃娃那样，只把你们几个夹起来放出去。</color>

Still have to follow the rules and conditions, hm? Then you have nothing to offer us but the illusion of omnipotence. Unremarkable.
看似全能，却受到条件的制约么。倒也没什么特别的。

<... She won't always have her eyes on us. She still has a department store to manage, after all.>
<……她应该不会一直盯着我们的。毕竟要管理百货店的话，就不能只盯着我们看。>

I'm starting to get a clearer picture, Executive Manager. Each "Giant" must also be responsible for overseeing an aspect of this place.
我了解大致情况了。看来每个巨人都管辖着不同的领域。

<color=#a5ab8e>Oh? Looks like she's more than just a paranoiac... Pfft, your friends each have something special about them, huh?</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>看来你并不只是生性多疑而已……噗，你的朋友们真是个个都异于常人。</color>

Um... May I ask you a question, Miss Jeanne? Why did you let us hear your Voice? Was it just because you were happy to see Meursault...?
那个……让娜小姐为什么要让我们听到您的声音呢？单纯只是因为您再次见到默尔索先生后感到很高兴吗……？

<color=#a5ab8e>At work, I'm usually... all by myself.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>我上班的时候……通常都是孤身一人。</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>I sit in one corner of this moderately-sized room that isn't too big or too small... staring into the unbearable vastness of the Grand Magasin like it's the most normal thing in the world to do.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>我待在一间不宽不窄的房间角落里，理所当然般地凝视着这家宽敞又巨大的百货店。</color>

... And?
……所以呢？

<color=#a5ab8e>You know, sometimes...</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>所以我只是偶尔……</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>... Sometimes I just want to talk about this feeling with someone.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>想和别人聊一聊这种感受。</color>

Care to elaborate—
那又是什么意思……

<color=#a5ab8e>Time to bid each other adieu. I know you're dying to see me, but try to exercise some restraint for now.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>我得走啦，就算想我也得麻烦你先忍忍啦。</color>

... I know you're still here.
……走什么走，她肯定还在盯着我们。

<color=#a5ab8e>... Boo, boring.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>……真没劲。</color>

I'm used to dealing with the likes of you.
……我很了解你这类人。

<color=#a5ab8e>Hey, don't take it too seriously. It's not often that I get to fool around like this at work.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>别这么较真嘛，我开个玩笑而已啦。我上班的时候很少像这样跟别人开玩笑。</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>Leaving for real now—tchao.</color>
<color=#a5ab8e>那我这次可真要走啦。</color>

... It doesn't feel all that real.
……我还是觉得不可思议。

<What doesn't?>
<什么东西不可思议啊？>

That Meursault of all people used to be romantically involved with someone.
关于默尔索先生曾经跟别人谈恋爱的事情……

Our relationship entailed elements that are no different from what is conventionally expected from "romantic partners."
和普通的恋人并没有差别。

We went on dates and spent time together.
我们彼此约会，共度时光。
